# Moving Average
```{r}
n <- nrow(data_mpdw)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

training_ma <- data_mpdw[1:n_train, ]
testing_ma <- data_mpdw[(n_train + 1):n, ]

training_ma.ts <- ts(training_ma$`Monthly Anomaly`)
testing_ma.ts <- ts(testing_ma$`Monthly Anomaly`)
```

```{r}
library(TTR)

# 1. Membuat Fungsi Pencarian
find_optimum_sma <- function(ts_data, max_n = 12) {
  # Menyiapkan kerangka data untuk menyimpan hasil
  results <- data.frame(n = integer(), MAPE = numeric(), RMSE = numeric())
  
  # Looping untuk mencoba n dari 2 hingga batas maksimal
  for (i in 2:max_n) {
    # Proses pemulusan SMA
    sma_fit <- SMA(ts_data, n = i)
    
    # Penyesuaian lag: SMA periode ke-t adalah ramalan untuk (t+1)
    aktual <- ts_data[(i+1):length(ts_data)]
    ramalan <- sma_fit[i:(length(ts_data)-1)] 
    
    # Perhitungan Error
    error <- aktual - ramalan
    mape <- mean(abs(error / aktual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Menyimpan hasil setiap iterasi ke dalam tabel
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(n = i, MAPE = mape, RMSE = rmse))
  }
  
  # 2. Menampilkan Tabel Evaluasi Lengkap
  cat("--- Hasil Evaluasi Akurasi Berbagai Nilai n ---\n")
  print(results)
  
  # 3. Mengekstrak n dengan MAPE terkecil
  best_n <- results$n[which.min(results$MAPE)]
  cat("\n============================================\n")
  cat("Nilai n optimum berdasarkan MAPE terkecil adalah:", best_n, "\n")
  cat("============================================\n")
  
  return(best_n)
}

# Eksekusi Fungsi pada data Anda
# max_n adalah batas maksimal periode yang ingin Anda uji (misal: 12 periode)
n_optimum <- find_optimum_sma(training_ma.ts, max_n = 12)

# Mengaplikasikan nilai n optimum ke model akhir Anda
data.sma_optimal <- SMA(training_ma.ts, n = n_optimum)
```

# Akurasi Data Latih
```{r}
error_train_sma <- training_ma.ts - data.ramal[1:length(training_ma.ts)]

SSE_train_sma <- sum(error_train_sma^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MSE_train_sma <- mean(error_train_sma^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MAPE_train_sma <- mean(abs(error_train_sma / training_ma.ts), na.rm = TRUE) * 100

akurasi_train_sma <- matrix(c(
  SSE = SSE_train_sma,
  MSE = MSE_train_sma,
  MAPE = MAPE_train_sma
))

row.names(akurasi_train_sma) <- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_train_sma) <- c("Nilai")
akurasi_train_sma

```
```{r}
library(forecast)

# Asumsi data awal:
# train_data : vektor data training (misal data 1:96)
# test_data  : vektor data testing (misal testing_ma.ts, data 97:120)
# n_ahead    : panjang periode testing (misal 24 periode)

cari_m_optimum_dma <- function(train_data, test_data, m_range = 2:8) {
  hasil_list <- list()
  n_test <- length(test_data)
  
  for (m in m_range) {
    n_train <- length(train_data)
    
    # 1. Single Moving Average
    sma <- stats::filter(train_data, rep(1/m, m), sides = 1)
    
    # 2. Double Moving Average (DMA)
    dma <- stats::filter(sma, rep(1/m, m), sides = 1)
    
    # Ambil nilai terakhir yang valid dari training
    At_last <- (2 * sma[n_train]) - dma[n_train]
    Bt_last <- (2 / (m - 1)) * (sma[n_train] - dma[n_train])
    
    # 3. Peramalan n-langkah ke depan (out-of-sample forecast untuk data testing)
    p <- 1:n_test
    forecast_test <- At_last + (Bt_last * p)
    
    # 4. Hitung Error terhadap data testing
    error_test <- test_data - forecast_test
    
    sse  <- sum(error_test^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    mse  <- mean(error_test^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    rmse <- sqrt(mse)
    mape <- mean(abs(error_test / test_data) * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    hasil_list[[as.character(m)]] <- c(m = m, SSE = sse, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAPE = mape)
  }
  
  # Gabungkan hasil ke dalam dataframe
  tabel_evaluasi <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, hasil_list))
  rownames(tabel_evaluasi) <- NULL
  
  # Urutkan berdasarkan MAPE terkecil
  tabel_evaluasi <- tabel_evaluasi[order(tabel_evaluasi$MAPE), ]
  
  # m terbaik
  m_optimum <- tabel_evaluasi$m[1]
  
  cat("=========================================\n")
  cat("Ringkasan Evaluasi Seluruh Nilai m:\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")
  print(tabel_evaluasi)
  cat("-----------------------------------------\n")
  cat(paste0(">>> Nilai m Optimum (MAPE Terkecil): m = ", m_optimum, 
             " (MAPE: ", round(tabel_evaluasi$MAPE[1], 4), "%)\n"))
  
  return(list(tabel = tabel_evaluasi, m_opt = m_optimum))
}
m_optimum_result <- cari_m_optimum_dma(training_ma.ts, testing_ma.ts, m_range = 2:8)
```

# Double Moving Averag
```{r}
dma <- SMA(data.sma, n = 2)
At <- 2*data.sma - dma
Bt <- 2/(2-1)*(data.sma - dma)
data.dma<- At+Bt
data.ramal2<- c(NA, data.dma)

t = 1:24
f = c()

for (i in t) {
  f[i] = At[length(At)] + Bt[length(Bt)]*(i)
}

data.gab2 <- cbind(aktual = c(data_mpdw.ts), 
                   pemulusan1 = c(data.sma,rep(NA,24)),
                   pemulusan2 = c(dma, rep(NA,24)),
                   At = c(At, rep(NA,24)), 
                   Bt = c(Bt,rep(NA,24)),
                   ramalan = c(data.ramal2, f[-1]))
data.gab2
```

```{r}
ts.plot(data_mpdw.ts, xlab="Time Period ", ylab="Sales", main= "DMA N=2 Data Sales")
points(data_mpdw.ts)
lines(data.gab2[,3],col="green",lwd=2)
lines(data.gab2[,6],col="red",lwd=2)
legend("topleft",c("data aktual","data pemulusan","data peramalan"), lty=8, col=c("black","green","red"), cex=0.8)

```
